name: MGR 流控(Flow Control)调优
description: Group Replication 的 Flow Control 机制在某个成员的 Certification 或 Applier 队列积压超过阈值时触发，强制降低整个集群的写入速率。Flow Control 触发后集群吞吐量急剧下降，TPS 可能从数千跌至几十。需要区分是参数设置不合理还是底层性能瓶颈导致的真实积压。

signals.desc: Certification 队列积压的事务数持续增高
Applier 队列积压持续增高
Flow Control 模式为 QUOTA 时已启用限流

conditions.desc: Certification 队列积压超过 100 个事务
Applier 队列积压超过 100 个事务

skip_when.desc: 节点正在做 Distributed Recovery（加入集群阶段），队列积压是正常的
集群只有单节点运行，Flow Control 不会触发

root_causes.name: Flow Control 阈值过低
root_causes.desc: group_replication_flow_control_certifier_threshold 和 applier_threshold 默认 25000，但某些场景下短时突发写入即可触发。如果底层硬件性能足够，可以适当调高阈值避免过早限流。

root_causes.name: Secondary 节点 Applier 性能不足
root_causes.desc: Secondary 节点磁盘 IO 慢、CPU 不足或 replica_parallel_workers 设置过低，导致事务 apply 速度跟不上 Primary 写入速度，Applier 队列持续积压。

root_causes.name: 大事务导致 Certification 积压
root_causes.desc: 单个大事务涉及大量行修改，Certification 过程耗时长，阻塞后续事务认证。MGR 对大事务非常敏感，单事务修改超过 150MB 可能导致 OOM。

root_causes.name: 网络延迟导致消息传播慢
root_causes.desc: 节点间网络延迟高（跨机房/跨地域部署），Paxos 共识需要多轮网络往返，导致 Certification 队列堆积。

step1_check_queue_depth.desc: 查看各成员的 Certification 和 Applier 队列深度
step1_check_queue_depth.sql: SELECT MEMBER_ID, COUNT_TRANSACTIONS_IN_QUEUE AS cert_queue, COUNT_TRANSACTIONS_REMOTE_IN_APPLIER_QUEUE AS applier_queue, COUNT_TRANSACTIONS_CHECKED AS total_certified, COUNT_TRANSACTIONS_REMOTE_APPLIED AS total_applied, COUNT_TRANSACTIONS_LOCAL_PROPOSED AS local_proposed FROM performance_schema.replication_group_member_stats

step2_check_flow_control_params.desc: 查看 Flow Control 相关参数
step2_check_flow_control_params.sql: SELECT VARIABLE_NAME, VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_variables WHERE VARIABLE_NAME LIKE 'group_replication_flow_control%' OR VARIABLE_NAME LIKE 'group_replication_transaction_size_limit%'

step3_check_member_status.sql: SELECT MEMBER_ID, MEMBER_HOST, MEMBER_PORT, MEMBER_STATE, MEMBER_ROLE FROM performance_schema.replication_group_members

step4_check_applier_workers.desc: 查看 Applier Worker 并行度和利用率
step4_check_applier_workers.sql: SELECT WORKER_ID, LAST_APPLIED_TRANSACTION, APPLYING_TRANSACTION, LAST_APPLIED_TRANSACTION_END_APPLY_TIMESTAMP FROM performance_schema.replication_applier_status_by_worker WHERE CHANNEL_NAME = 'group_replication_applier' ORDER BY WORKER_ID

step5_check_large_trx.desc: 检查是否有大事务正在执行
step5_check_large_trx.sql: SELECT trx_id, trx_state, trx_started, trx_rows_modified, trx_rows_locked, ROUND(trx_rows_modified * 0.001, 1) AS est_size_kb FROM information_schema.innodb_trx WHERE trx_rows_modified > 10000 ORDER BY trx_rows_modified DESC

step6_network_latency_indicator.desc: 通过 Certification 延迟间接判断网络状况
step6_network_latency_indicator.sql: SELECT MEMBER_ID, COUNT_TRANSACTIONS_IN_QUEUE, COUNT_TRANSACTIONS_CHECKED, ROUND(COUNT_TRANSACTIONS_IN_QUEUE / GREATEST(COUNT_TRANSACTIONS_CHECKED, 1) * 100, 2) AS queue_ratio_pct FROM performance_schema.replication_group_member_stats

caused_by.name: MGR 网络分区与脑裂
caused_by.relationship: 网络问题导致消息传播延迟，间接引起队列积压

causes_of.name: MGR 成员管理
causes_of.relationship: 持续积压可能导致节点被判定为不健康并被移除

related.name: 并行复制调优

steps.risk: 关闭后 Secondary 延迟可能急剧增大

version_specific_notes.8.0: Flow Control 参数：certifier_threshold 和 applier_threshold 默认 25000。group_replication_flow_control_min_quota 和 max_quota 可精细控制限流力度。group_replication_transaction_size_limit 默认 150MB
version_specific_notes.8.4: Flow Control 算法优化，限流更平滑。新增更多 Flow Control 监控指标。group_replication_paxos_single_leader 支持单 leader 优化减少 Certification 延迟

real_world_examples.scenario: 电商大促期间 MGR 集群 TPS 突然从 3000 跌至 20
real_world_examples.symptoms: 大促开始 10 分钟后订单接口超时。检查发现 Flow Control 触发，某 Secondary 节点 Applier 队列积压 8000+
real_world_examples.root_cause: Secondary 节点磁盘 IO 是 SATA SSD，写入 IOPS 不足。大促写入量激增后 apply 跟不上，触发 Flow Control 拖慢整个集群
real_world_examples.resolution: 紧急将该节点临时移出集群（SET GLOBAL group_replication_force_members），集群恢复为 2 节点后 TPS 立即恢复。后续将 Secondary 节点磁盘升级为 NVMe
real_world_examples.result: 集群 TPS 恢复到 3500，后续所有节点使用统一硬件规格
